Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. This is a 12 month Fixed-Term position, and includes full benefits.
As a Lead Client Partner, you will play a pivotal role in driving business results for Pinterest’s largest strategic advertisers. Your expertise throughout the funnel will help you grow and nurture client relationships and guide them from awareness through to conversion and retention.

We’re looking for a Client Partner to help our most strategic partners successfully grow their business through Pinterest. You’ll work directly with some of our key advertisers as a trusted consultant to their business. Your strategic advice, analytical skills and sales skills are core to bringing to life the value we deliver as a platform.
We invite passionate candidates to join our Enterprise CPG Sales team!

Retain, grow and diversify the value delivered to our partners, ultimately growing Pinterest revenue as a result.
Coordinate negotiations with partners to create joint business plans, learning agendas and have deep understanding of partners' business and media objectives. Responsible for stakeholder management, decision maker relationships. Arrange regular meetings with partners to discuss their requirements, learn about their objectives and remove roadblocks for partners.
Orchestrate internal support for the client and agency to solve high level strategic challenges, from measurement to creative and technical integration to deliver consistent goals and objectives of the partners on a day to day.
Track, analyze, and communicate key quantitative metrics and business trends internally and to partners.
Specifically own the “why” Pinterest conversation with advertisers to influence the way they think about the platform’s role in their overarching media mix.
Present tailored digital media strategies to partners that address their specific marketing needs and align with their business goals. Have a deep understanding of partners’ business goals and turn data into compelling stories through actionable insights to help them succeed. Leverage knowledge of the broader digital and advertising landscape, competitive platforms, and industry landscape to provide insights.
Apply knowledge of customer goals and joint strategy to increase ad investment. Secure and grow revenue for Pinterest through proactive planning, pitching, deal negotiations, and upselling. Unlock new lines of revenue by navigating across multiple lines of business, marketing objectives, regions. Influences and secures budget allocation from Search, Social, Brand, Video, Agency and other relevant teams.
Provide partners with guidance and expertise on product and service best practices and features.
Be highly knowledgeable about all relevant Pinterest ad product features and capable of clearly explaining their benefits to a customer.
Leverage AI to manage pipeline velocity and deal hygiene, including opportunity tracking, forecasting preparation, and weekly reporting, ensuring more time is spent in front of clients rather than behind a spreadsheet.
Maintain up-to-date education and fluency on evolving product roadmap and iterations.
Efficiently interfaces with appropriate cross-functional teams to answer product-related questions or challenges when needed.
AI utilization: Understand and test various tools & approaches to aid in meeting preparation, performance analysis and ultimately enable prioritize high impact outcomes with velocity.

Growth mindset & open-mindedness to new techniques, skill development and AI-led workflows to drive success at scale across a diverse set of advertisers.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Marketing, or equivalent experience.
Experience in marketing/advertising/digital, with specific technical acumen in Search/Shopping/Display/Social advertising technologies.
Established industry relationships and experience working with executive level business and marketing leaders within client organizations.
Proven track record of exceeding revenue goals.
Ability to translate partner value across various levels, such as executive, operational, creative, media, and analytics teams.
Strong team player and ability to succeed in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment while maintaining high levels of operational rigor, digital acumen, and business excellence.
Expertise in digital advertising and media sales including campaign optimization, analytical problem solving, and product/platform knowledge.
Utilization of AI to craft personalized, high-quality client communications at speed, from outreach and follow-ups to QBR presentations and renewal proposals, maintaining a consultative tone grounded in data and platform expertise.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Marketing, or equivalent experience.

Up to €86k OTE | Uncapped Commission | Territory Ownership
The Opportunity Do you want the freedom to work completely independently, but with the backing of a global tech leader?
We are looking for a Field Account Executive to conquer the Berlin hospitality market. In this role, you aren’t just an employee; you are the owner of your specific territory. You will have full freedom to plan your day, build your own network, and manage your sales pipe.
We don't care about micromanagement; we care about results. You will be measured on your success, with a transparent promotion path based purely on revenue milestones.
***Note that this role is based in Berlin, Germany***
Your Journey with Us
Month 1 (Onboarding): We invest in you. You will undergo a comprehensive 1-month onboarding program to master the product, the market, and our sales methodology.
Month 2 & Beyond: You get your territory in Berlin. It’s yours to map, hunt, and harvest.

Active Field Presence: You will be present in the Berlin market daily. Your primary approach is face-to-face interaction—visiting restaurants, cafes, and bars to introduce them to Lightspeed personally.
Full Cycle Ownership: You control the process from the very first handshake to the signed contract. You are responsible for self-sourcing, prospecting, demoing, and closing.
Consultative Selling: You aren't just selling software; you are helping restaurateurs build better businesses. You will listen to their needs and build custom solutions.
Build Your Network: You will become a known face in your local hospitality scene, building long-term relationships and a referral network.

A Hunter: You love the thrill of the chase. You are self-motivated and don't need someone looking over your shoulder to get work done.
German Native/Fluent: You have excellent communication skills in German (essential for building trust with local owners) and are comfortable in English.

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.
For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.
AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.
At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience.

But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.
We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.
Check out our principles to see how we work.

You will be pivotal for telli's growth. Your mission is to drive revenue by building trusted relationships with enterprise customers and closing deals. As our first experienced enterprise sales hire, you'll help us 10x telli from the ground up.

Own large deals end-to-end: Discovery, demos, security review, procurement, contract redlines, you carry the deal from the first call through signature uncovering telli’s value for the customer
Generate the your own pipeline: Our BDR team supports you; they don't replace you. You target the accounts, you write the outbound, you make the calls
Multi-thread complex buying committees: Heads of Sales, Operations, CX, Legal, IT, Security, Procurement, and CFOs at companies of 500 to 10,000+ employees. You build the relationships before procurement comes in to test them
Own a quota and hit revenue targets: Close large deals that meaningfully contribute to telli’s growth
Shape telli's enterprise playbook: qualification, multi-thread strategy, executive engagement, pricing. What works for you becomes the team standard
Feed structured signal back into product, marketing, and strategy: You sit closest to the customer. Your input shapes what we build next

Bei Klim schaffen wir gemeinsam mit Landwirten und Unternehmen eine Bewegung, um regenerative Landwirtschaft skalierbar und wirkungsvoll zu machen. Als AgriTech-Startup mit Sitz in Berlin arbeiten wir mit Landwirten, Böden zu regenerieren, die Biodiversität zu fördern und Kohlenstoff zu binden – und über unsere Plattform erhalten Landwirte dafür eine faire Vergütung.
Mit einer Series-A-Finanzierung in Höhe von 22 Millionen US-Dollar expandieren wir weltweit und arbeiten mit führenden Unternehmen der Lebensmittelindustrie wie Nestlé und Kaufland zusammen, um ihnen dabei zu helfen, die Emissionen entlang ihrer Lieferketten zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig ihre Widerstandsfähigkeit und Rentabilität zu steigern.

Seit 2020 haben wir 4.000 Landwirte überzeugt, die 800.000 Hektar (5 % der landwirtschaftlichen Nutzfläche Deutschlands!) bewirtschaften, und sind nun der führende Anbieter von Scope-3-Lösungen in Europa!

Du überzeugst Landwirte und Landwirtinnen, mit uns in den Projekten zusammenzuarbeiten und offen für eine langfristige Schritt-für-Schritt Erweiterung von regenerativen Maßnahmen zu sein.

Du stellst sicher, dass die Projektziele erfüllt werden und du entwickelst kreative Methoden, falls diese in Gefahr geraten.

Du hast mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung und bringst Kompetenzen im Projektmanagement und Gemüsebau mit. Im besten Fall hast Du bereits Kontaktpunkte mit regenerativer Landwirtschaft und den Herausforderungen der Landwirtschaftsbranche.

Own and grow a high-value partnership pipeline , from first and ongoing conversations to contract signature and sales enablement with a variety of partners ranging from start-ups to established carbon credit marketplaces. Research, structure, carry-out and review a partnership strategy to engage qualified and new market segments. Understand and communicate successes, risks, and mitigations transparent to management through optimized reporting and utilization of our CRM.

Who we are
Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched. Tables run every clinical trial, every financial model, every scientific experiment, every business decision, and no one had built a foundation model that truly understood them.
Until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. The next modality shift in AI is happening, and we're hiring the team that makes it.
Momentum. We pioneered tabular foundation models and are now the world-leading organization in structured-data ML. Our TabPFN v2 model was published as a Nature cover story and set a new state of the art for tabular machine learning.

Since release we've scaled model capabilities 20x+, passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and are seeing accelerating adoption across research and industry - from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi to improving clinical-trial decisions with BostonGene .
The hardest work is ahead. We're scaling tabular foundation models to millions of rows, thousands of features, real-time inference, and entirely new data modalities, while building the infrastructure to run them in production across some of the most demanding industries on earth. These are open problems no one else is working on at this level.
Our team. We're a small, highly selective team of 30+ engineers, researchers, and GTM specialists, with backgrounds spanning Google, Apple, Amazon, DeepMind, Meta, Microsoft Research, G-Research, Jane Street, Goldman Sachs, and CERN. We're led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by world-leading AI researchers including Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. We ship fast, do top-tier research, and hold each other to an extremely high bar.
What's next. In 2025 we raised €9m pre-seed led by Balderton Capital, backed by leaders from Hugging Face, DeepMind, and Black Forest Labs. The next phase of growth is here, which makes this an ideal time to join.

We are hiring our first Account Executive to drive commercial adoption of our foundation models for structured data. This is a founding role — you'll shape how we sell, who we sell to, and what good looks like for every AE who joins after you. You'll own the full sales cycle across enterprise and mid-market accounts, working directly with the commercial founder and a team of ex-DeepMind, Palantir, Jane Street, Goldman Sachs and Amazon researchers and operators.
This role combines a strong outbound focus with the potential for end-to-end deal ownership. You'll spend most of your time on outreach and discovery with technical buyers (data scientists, ML engineers, technical leaders), while also navigating buying committees, developing proposals, and closing deals.

You'll help create the materials and messaging that make our outbound motion successful while driving revenue outcomes. We're looking for someone who loves the craft of outbound and wants to build the engine, not just close deals.

Company Description
Wiser is the market intelligence platform built to help brands and retailers win at the decision point, the moment a shopper chooses to buy or walk away. Wiser’s platform combines real-time data with category-specific expertise to convert visibility into action across all online channels.
With visibility across 10 billion products, 130+ million ecommerce pages, and 150,000 sellers, Wiser empowers teams to act quickly, confidently, and competitively, to guide the shopper journey and capture more sales. Wiser’s intelligence spans pricing, promotions, assortment, availability, compliance, and more. Trusted by 750+ customers worldwide, Wiser turns data into decisive action.
Job Description
If you’re smart, willing to hustle and have a proven track record of success selling at the highest levels, we want you to join us!
By joining Wiser, you’ll be part of an amazing global organization that’s shaping the way brands and retailers use online and instore to grow and scale their operations.
The market opportunity is huge: eCommerce continues to grow year-over-year at a double-digit rate. And as more people shop online, the need for brands and retailers to understand how they’re positioned in the market is growing with that.
Our technology drives in-depth data collection so that marketing, merchandising, sales and analytics teams are empowered with live data to make better informed decisions around pricing, product assortment and promotional activity.
Essential Functions (details of the job)
Cultivate new business opportunities within assigned territory.
Own and execute the full sales cycle from prospecting through close.
Identify key influencers within target accounts.
Effectively navigate strategic customer/prospect conversations to uncover core business challenges.
Connect our solutions with prospective customers’ pain points.
Communicate our value proposition to position against the status quo and competitors.
Develop proposals focused on addressing prospective client organizations’ needs at scale.
Identify the right stakeholders to define timelines and compelling events that drive deals to close.
Partner closely with CSMs to grow the existing book of business while exceeding new business targets.
Stay closely aligned with customer accounts through renewal cycles to identify expansion opportunities, support renewals, and help mitigate at-risk accounts.
Must be comfortable performing product demos via Microsoft Teams or similar technology.
Share ideas and perspective on Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), product marketing needs, sales collateral, and new approaches to prospecting.
Maintain regular and reliable work attendance.

2-3+ years experience in selling software or SaaS solutions experience
Fluent in Spanish and English (required)
Background selling to brands and/or retailers a plus
Comfortable being on the phone/video/client facing
Certification in and strong belief in consultative sales methodology
Must be able to uncover and quantify customers/prospects complex business challenges
Proactive, organized, and detail-oriented
Results-driven and able to think quickly on your feet
Problem solver that isn’t afraid to make the tough ask
Coachable and eager to learn
Team player

Wir suchen eine:n Business Development Manager:in für unseren Standort in Hamburg, der/die aktiv neue Kund:innen gewinnt und das Wachstum von Nelly konsequent vorantreibt.
Was dich in der Rolle als Business Development Manager:in erwartet
Als Business Development Manager:in qualifizierst du neue Leads, sprichst gezielt Entscheider:innen an und führst den Sales-Prozess von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum Abschluss. Du erkennst Wachstumspotenziale frühzeitig, arbeitest zielorientiert an Abschlüssen und bringst Markt- und Kundenfeedback in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Customer Success und Product ein.
Über Nelly
Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann.

Unsere All-In-One Plattform verwandelt chaotische administrative Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Arbeitsabläufe, von der Patientenbetreuung über die Abrechnung bis hin zu Zahlungen der nächsten Generation. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben.
Warum? Europa ist mit einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachkräften konfrontiert. Wenn wir die Arbeitsweise von Praxen nicht überdenken, wird das System nicht mithalten können. Mit unserer Series B Finanzierung in Höhe von über 50 Millionen Euro von Weltklasse-Investoren setzen wir unsere Vision in die Tat um.
Was dich erwartet: Wir arbeiten mit dem besten Team und geben gemeinsam jeden Tag alles. Wir setzen auf Talent Density, weil außergewöhnliche Menschen alle um sie herum besser machen. Bei Nelly bewegen wir uns schnell und erwarten, dass alle mithalten. Stillstand ist keine Option, deshalb investieren wir stark in Weiterentwicklung.

KI ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have. Wir erwarten, dass du sie täglich nutzt und geben dir alle Möglichkeiten, dies zu tun. Du bekommst Vertrauen und Verantwortung, dafür erwarten wir, dass du Dinge ansprichst, auch wenn es unbequem ist.
Deine Rolle bei Nelly
Du gewinnst aktiv neue Partner:innen : Von der Identifikation potenzieller Leads über den Erstkontakt (inkl. Kaltakquise), Pitch & Demo bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss übernimmst du den gesamten Sales-Funnel.
Du berätst medizinische Einrichtungen auf Augenhöhe : Du verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen die passende Lösung aus unserem Produktportfolio.
Du führst souveräne Verhandlungen : Ob Praxisinhaber:in, Ärzt:innen oder Verwaltungsleitung – du überzeugst verschiedene Entscheidungsträger:innen mit Empathie, Klarheit und Verhandlungsgeschick.
KPI-getriebenes Arbeiten: Du arbeitest datenbasiert, steuerst deinen Funnel effizient und behältst deine Ziele und Kennzahlen stets im Blick
Das bringst du mit
Erste Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb , idealerweise im SaaS- oder FinTech-Bereich – oder du überzeugst uns mit deinem Drive und Lernhunger .
Keine Scheu vor Kaltakquise : Du gehst proaktiv auf Menschen zu und siehst in jedem Gespräch die Chance, echten Mehrwert zu schaffen.
Starke Kommunikationsskills : Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte klar, empathisch und verbindlich vermitteln – schriftlich wie mündlich.
Motivation, Disziplin und Resilienz zeichnen dich aus – du bleibst dran, auch wenn es mal herausfordernd wird.
Neugier & Struktur : Du stellst gezielte Fragen, um die Bedürfnisse deiner Gesprächspartner:innen wirklich zu verstehen, und gehst systematisch vor.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und solide Englischkenntnisse helfen dir, mit unseren Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen erfolgreich zusammenzuarbeiten.

At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!
What We Do…
We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.
We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.
And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.
As a Business Development Manager you will be a key driver of new business growth across the DACH region, engaging and advising customers across various segments from small independent hotels and boutique properties to large hotel groups and travel tech partners.

You will be joining and representing the leading AI technology platform redefining guest acquisition and hotel revenue management. You will be relied on not just to close new business but to strategically influence pipeline growth, long-term partnerships and commercial excellence.
We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success. You will be supported by a dedicated sales coach and a buddy, as well as your team leader, who will coach, guide and motivate you to achieve your professional goals.
We know that an attractive compensation package is a key motivator in sales. SiteMinder offers you not only this, but also a working environment that represents ambition, collaboration, self-development and customer-centricity. If you identify with our core values ( We Hustle, We Come Together, We Grow, We Make Things Simple ) and you are a sales hunter at heart and able to work at a fast pace, we want to hear from you!

Lead full-cycle sales and business development: identify, engage and convert new prospects into customers.
Strategic territory and pipeline growth: define and execute strategic qualification routines, build segmented pipelines from your territory, and prioritise opportunities that deliver high value.
Consistently achieving sales KPIs and targets: work towards daily, weekly and monthly targets. Accountability will be important to help you succeed.
Trusted advisor engagement: conduct insightful discovery and product presentations, consulting on clients’ business and commercial goals, and present proposals to clients in a professional and confident manner. Negotiate contracts as required, maintaining a balance between optimal service and value for the client and SiteMinder's profit margins.
CRM ownership & intelligence: maintain disciplined CRM practices to ensure pipeline, forecasts, reporting, and customer insights are accurate and actionable.
Collaborate across functions: partner with Onboarding, Marketing, Product and Customer Success teams to refine market messaging, feedback loops, and go-to-market strategies that will improve our competitiveness.
Representing the company: work with local industry groups and travel associations to promote SiteMinder’s products and brand. Attend key functions and events, support webinars and other tactical initiatives to raise brand awareness, requiring occasional travel to client locations to attend meetings with relevant managers.
What You Have...
Sales & business development experience: extensive experience closing deals with full-cycle responsibility, ideally across SaaS, hospitality technology, hotel operations, revenue management, or related commercial services.
Industry fluency: solid understanding of the hospitality value chain (hotel management, revenue strategy, guest acquisition…).
Consultative and outcome-focused sales skills: demonstrated ability to diagnose business needs, tailor solutions and influence decision-making with impact.
Remote-ready communication & autonomy: excellent verbal and written communicator, strong listener, adept at building rapport and driving processes without day-to-day supervision.
Resilience & growth mindset: high level of self-motivation, curiosity to learn continuously and openness to feedback and coaching.
Analytical and tech-savvy: strong proficiency with CRM and sales tools.
Fluent in German (min. C2) and professional proficiency in English.

Werde Account Manager (m/w/d) bei Carwow
Unsere Mission
Wir wollen die erste Anlaufstelle für den Autowechsel werden. Mit einer Kombination aus Technologie, Medien und tiefem Verständnis für den Automobilsektor haben wir schon jetzt die Art wie Menschen Autos (ver)kaufen, vermarkten und leasen, auf den Kopf gestellt.
Was als einfache Neuwagen-Vergleichsplattform begann, ist heute einer der größten Online-Marktplätze für den Autowechsel in Europa. Im letzten Jahr allein sind wir dabei mit Fahrzeugen, die im Wert von über 5 Mrd. € über unser Portal gekauft, geleast oder versteigert wurden, um über 50% gewachsen.
2024 haben wir mit der Übernahme von Autovia – der Plattform hinter AutoExpress und dem Evo Magazin – unsere Reichweite über Nacht verdoppelt. Zusammen zählen wir nun mit fast 10 Mio. Abonnenten und 1,1 Mrd. jährlichen Aufrufen zu den größten YouTube-Kanälen der Welt. Daneben verkaufen wir 1,2 Mio. Kopien unseres Print-Magazins und erreichen jährlich über 350 Mio. Menschen mit unserem Web-Content.
Und wir sind noch lange nicht fertig.
Dein Impact @ Carwow
Mit Get Your Car Used und Sell My Car bauen wir die führende Plattform für den digitalen Fahrzeughandel auf. Unser Ziel ist es, Händler dabei zu unterstützen, Fahrzeuge effizienter zu kaufen, zu verkaufen und ihren Bestand erfolgreicher zu vermarkten.
Dafür suchen wir dich als Account Manager (m/w/d) mit Fokus auf Get Your Car Used .
Du verantwortest den Erfolg und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Händlerpartner auf der Plattform und sorgst dafür, dass sie das volle Potenzial unserer Produkte ausschöpfen.
Dabei arbeitest du eng an der Schnittstelle zwischen Carwow Used und Sell My Car und unterstützt Händler dabei, beide Plattformen erfolgreich im Tagesgeschäft zu nutzen.
Deine Aufgaben als Account Manager (m/w/d)
Du betreust und entwickelst aktiv unsere Händlerpartner auf Carwow Used und Sell My Car weiter und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Performance auf der Plattform nachhaltig zu steigern
Du führst Onboardings, Trainings und regelmäßige Performance-Reviews durch und identifizierst Potenziale zur Verbesserung von Aktivität, Leads, Fahrzeugvermarktung, Geboten und Transaktionen
Dabei verstehst du die Bedürfnisse unserer Händler genau und fungierst als zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in zwischen unseren Partnern und den internen Teams bei Carwow
Zusätzlich analysierst du relevante KPIs und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen und Handlungsempfehlungen ab, um Wachstum und Engagement unserer Händler zu steigern
Das macht dich aus
Hinweis: Idealerweise bringst du (erste) Erfahrungen aus einer ähnlichen Rolle mit und hast ein Verständnis für die Automobilbranche und/oder digitale Marktplätze.
Dennoch: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100%. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifizierst und dir die Aufgaben zutraust, dann freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.
Denn wir wollen gemeinsam mit dir wachsen.

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
We're looking for a driven, consultative Commercial Account Executive to spearhead DeepL's expansion across Italy , with a strong focus on strategic outbound business development.

This is an exceptional opportunity to leverage DeepL's world class brand presence and market position to proactively engage, educate, and build lasting relationships with new clients across this dynamic region.

You'll take ownership of driving the full sales process from initial strategic outreach to closing, playing a vital role in expanding our commercial footprint.
Being based in London, this role offers the chance to shape a high growth territory within Southern Europe .

You'll strategically identify target organisations, craft meaningful outreach, and partner with key decision makers in organisations up to 500 employees, seeing the direct impact of your work as DeepL solidifies its position as the go to AI translation and communication solution in Italy.

If you're energised by generating new opportunities, solving complex client communication challenges, and being part of a highly collaborative international team, we would love to hear from you.

Drive strategic outbound business development and territory growth
Lead proactive market expansion: Identify, reach out to, and build relationships with key decision makers across target commercial accounts in Italy.
Build and nurture a high quality pipeline: Design and execute thoughtful, tailored outreach campaigns across multiple channels using email, phone, and LinkedIn to generate new business opportunities.
Become a trusted ambassador for DeepL's products and an expert on Italian enterprise needs, tailoring conversations to solve real organisational challenges.
Guide prospects through a consultative sales cycle by qualifying leads, leading insightful discovery sessions, presenting tailored solution demonstrations, and closing deals.
Maximise value for clients by exploring upselling and expansion opportunities as relationships mature.
Seamlessly manage inbound inquiries alongside your outbound initiatives to maximise territory potential.
Achieve and exceed targets in a supportive environment
Consistently work toward achieving monthly activity, pipeline generation, and revenue goals.
Maintain accurate CRM forecasting and account insights to ensure clear tracking of customer needs, timelines, and strategy.
Collaborate closely with cross functional partners including SDRs, Marketing, and Product teams to co create strategies that drive regional success.
Qualities we look for
Experience and expertise
Proven track record in full cycle SaaS sales , with strong experience in proactive prospecting, pipeline creation, and closing new business.
Experience engaging and partnering with accounts up to 500 employees.
Strong alignment with consultative sales approaches by focusing on active listening, understanding client pain points, and delivering value.
Strategic, curious mindset with a strong sense of ownership over your territory growth.
Skills and attributes
Exceptional relationship building, presentation, and communication skills both written and verbal.
High adaptability and problem solving skills, comfortable navigating dynamic, fast paced environments.
Goal oriented and persistent, with a passion for initiating business conversations and creating momentum.
Strong team player who values collaboration, mutual support, and sharing knowledge across teams.
Fluency in Italian and English is essential.

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.
Dein Profil
Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2) , High-Growth Start-ups (idealerweise Business Development oder Sales), oder im VC-Umfeld gesammelt
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Energiewirtschaft, Entrepreneurship oder einem verwandten Feld)
Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg
Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit
Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten
Du strebst danach, die beste Version deiner selbst zu werden und suchst Umgebungen, in denen du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst
Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) – unser Büro ist unser Homebase
Du sprichst Deutsch fließend (C2) und kannst komplexe Produkte verständlich erklären
Deine Aufgaben
Mission der Rolle
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Gründer Julius (CEO) zusammen und bist wesentlicher Bestandteil unserer Enterprise Unit.
Dein Ziel: Du überzeugst die größten Portfoliobesitzer von Mehrfamilienhäusern deutschlandweit von VREY. Dabei arbeitest du aktiv am Aufbau unserer Business Unit "Enterprise" mit und verkaufst selbst an Wohnungsimmobilien- und Genossenschaften, um Bedürfnisse tiefgreifend zu verstehen.
Mitaufbau unseres größten Wachstumskanals
Du bist einer der ersten zwei Vollzeit-Hires im Enterprise Team und arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO zusammen, um den Kanal effizient und reproduzierbar zu machen
Du unterstützt den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung des Teams
Du akquirierst Kunden und denkst dabei bereits in langfristigen Partnerschaften und skalierbaren Systemen
Business Development & kommerzielle Exzellenz
Du arbeitest eng mit dem Enterprise Lead und unserem Growth-Team zusammen, um fortlaufend GTM-Hypothesen zu testen und erfolgreiche Modelle schnell zu skalieren
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Pipeline, Abschlüsse und Umsatzbeiträge
Du bringst Ideen ein, testest diese Hands-on und hast einen starken Fokus auf Execution
Unterstützung bei Lead Generation und Revenue Operations
Du unterstützt bei RevOps Prozessen, die mit unserem Wachstum mithalten
Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Enterprise-Praktikanten zusammen, um eine repetitive Lead Engine zu etablieren
Du hilfst beim Aufbau einfacher, effektiver Strukturen (z. B. CRM, Reporting, Automatisierungen), die uns schneller und besser machen

Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen
Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet
Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket
Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten
Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss
Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt . Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen.
Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist und glaubst, einen Beitrag leisten zu können, möchten wir von dir hören!
Der beste Weg ist eine warme Intro: Kennst du jemand, der auf diese Rolle passt? Empfiehl die Person und erhalte 3.000€ bei erfolgreicher Einstellung.
Voraussetzung: Die Person ist uns noch nicht bei uns im Prozess und wird offiziell vorgeschlagen. Auszahlung nach bestandener Probezeit. Bei mehrfacher Nennung zählt die erste eingegangene Empfehlung.

Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.
Dein Profil
Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2) , High-Growth Start-ups (idealerweise Business Development, Partnerships oder Sales), oder im VC-Umfeld gesammelt
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Energiewirtschaft, Entrepreneurship oder einem verwandten Feld)
Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg
Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit
Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten
Du strebst danach, die beste Version deiner selbst zu werden und suchst Umgebungen, in denen du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst
Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) – unser Büro ist unser Homebase
Du sprichst Deutsch fließend (C2) und kannst komplexe Produkte verständlich erklären
Deine Aufgaben
Mission der Rolle
Du arbeitest eng mit Konrad (Head of Growth) zusammen und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau eines der wichtigsten GTM-Units unseres Unternehmens.
Dein Ziel: Strukturen, Prozesse und Initiativen zu entwickeln, die es uns ermöglichen, die Energiewende in Mehrfamilienhäusern deutschlandweit schnell und skalierbar umzusetzen. Dabei baust du zunächst federführend unsere Business Unit “Partnerships” auf - mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf unseren Unternehmenserfolg.
1. Aufbau & Skalierung eines zentralen Wachstumskanals
Du bist einer der Key Hires für unser Business Development Team und arbeitest mit externen Stakeholdern zusammen, um den neuen Kanal effizient und reproduzierbar zu machen
Du übernimmst Ownership für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung eines skalierbaren Partner- und Projektkanals
Du denkst nicht in einzelnen Partnerschaften, sondern in skalierbaren Systemen
2. Business Development & kommerzielle Exzellenz
Du arbeitest eng mit Growth, Sales und dem CEO zusammen, um fortlaufend GTM-Hypothesen zu testen und erfolgreiche Modelle schnell zu skalieren
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Pipeline, Abschlüsse und Umsatzbeiträge
Du bringst Ideen ein, testest diese Hands-on und hast einen starken Fokus auf Execution
3. Ownership für GTM und Revenue Operations
Du nutzt die Learnings für den Aufbau von weiteren Business-Units in der Zukunft
Du entwickelst und verantwortest RevOps Prozesse, die mit unserem Wachstum mithalten
Du baust einfache, effektive Strukturen (z. B. CRM, Reporting, Automatisierungen), die uns schneller und besser machen

Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen
Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet
Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket
Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten
Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss
Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt . Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen.
Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist und glaubst, einen Beitrag leisten zu können, möchten wir von dir hören!
Der beste Weg ist eine warme Intro: Kennst du jemand, der auf diese Rolle passt? Empfiehl die Person und erhalte 3.000€ bei erfolgreicher Einstellung.
Voraussetzung: Die Person ist uns noch nicht bei uns im Prozess und wird offiziell vorgeschlagen. Auszahlung nach bestandener Probezeit. Bei mehrfacher Nennung zählt die erste eingegangene Empfehlung.

Through our 7,000 automated kiosks and online marketplace Gazelle.com, we enable people all over the world to join the mobile device re-use revolution, a revolution that will get billions of used smartphones out of the e-waste cycle and into the hands of people who don’t have affordable access to the empowerment of the latest mobile technology.

Role Summary ecoATM is looking for an experienced, strategic Senior Manager of Account Management to own and grow a portfolio of our retail partnerships.

This is a senior individual-contributor role built for someone with real account management chops — someone who can dig into the numbers and turn them into a presentation that lands in the room, stay organized while juggling hundreds of store launches at once, transform a chaotic spreadsheet into something genuinely useful, and keep a retailer relationship strong even when things get bumpy.

This role carries all the seniority, scope, and autonomy of a Senior Manager or Director-level account leader — without the people-management load. It's built for someone who wants to stay close to the account, not manage a team. What You Will Do:

Account Ownership: Own the relationship and act as the primary point of contact for your assigned retail accounts.

Account Planning: Build and execute account plans that grow kiosk placements, improve performance, and deepen ecoATM's integration with each partner.

Data-Driven Insights: Analyze retailer and internal performance data to identify issues and build data-backed recommendations for new placements and optimization.

Business Reviews: Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and joint business planning that connect ecoATM's performance to each retailer's own strategic and financial priorities.

Executive & Stakeholder Relationships: Cultivate relationships across a retailer's HQ — merchandising, operations, real estate/asset protection, sustainability — to multi-thread the relationship and reduce single-point-of-contact risk.

Escalation Management: Manage problem resolution with urgency, conducting root-cause analysis and coordinating internally to protect the partnership.

Marketing Partnership : Work with marketing teams to increase kiosk visibility and drive incremental foot traffic within partner locations. Develop and support initiatives that enhance in-store awareness and customer engagement.

Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with operations & regulatory teams to execute new kiosk installs smoothly.

Market Awareness: Track industry trends and competitive activity, using real-time insight to spot new opportunities within your accounts.

Business Development Support: Partner with the Business Development team on channel expansion opportunities and the onboarding of newly signed accounts within your territory.

Forecasting & Planning : Manage account level installation and removal forecasts

Customer Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of the customer, ensuring retailer feedback shapes product, marketing, and operational decisions.

About Emerald Emerald ’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce.

We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in-person and digital platforms and channels.

For more information, please visit ASD Market Week is one of the largest and longest-running business-to-business general merchandise trade shows in the United States.

Held twice annually in Las Vegas, ASD connects thousands of retailers, distributors, importers, and e-commerce businesses with manufacturers, wholesalers, and suppliers from around the world.

With more than 1,800 vendors, approximately 30,000 attendees, and over one million products across 19+ merchandise categories, ASD provides exhibitors with a powerful platform to meet new customers, enter new markets, build brand visibility, and write business directly on the show floor.

We are seeking a motivated, commercially driven Account Executive to grow exhibitor and sponsorship revenue for ASD Market Week. The Account Executive will manage the complete sales cycle—from identifying and prospecting new business opportunities through discovery, proposal development, negotiation, closing, and renewal.

This role will primarily engage manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, importers, suppliers, and consumer-product brands that would benefit from reaching ASD’s diverse community of retail buyers.

The successful candidate will be a proactive new-business hunter who is comfortable conducting high-volume outbound prospecting, building relationships with senior decision-makers, and presenting tailored event solutions that deliver measurable value to customers. Key Responsibilities New Business Development
Identify and prospect manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, suppliers, and emerging brands that align with ASD Market Week’s buyer community.
Generate new business through telephone outreach, email campaigns, LinkedIn, industry research, referrals, inbound leads, networking, and competitive-event prospecting.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified exhibit and sponsorship opportunities.
Develop targeted prospecting strategies across relevant product categories, including general merchandise, fashion and accessories, beauty and wellness, gift and home, toys, convenience-store products, closeouts, liquidation, and private-label manufacturing.
Re-engage dormant, lapsed, and previously lost exhibitors with relevant and compelling commercial proposals.
Consultative Sales and Closing
Own the full sales cycle from initial outreach and qualification through proposal, negotiation, contracting, and close.
Conduct effective discovery conversations to understand each prospect’s products, target customers, business objectives, challenges, and growth strategy.
Clearly communicate ASD Market Week’s value proposition and demonstrate how participation can help customers generate leads, meet qualified buyers, enter new markets, increase brand visibility, and grow revenue.
Recommend appropriate booth packages, sponsorships, digital products, marketing opportunities, and other solutions based on customer needs and objectives.
Prepare proposals, negotiate commercial terms, overcome objections, create urgency, and consistently move opportunities toward close.
Meet or exceed individual revenue, new-business, renewal, activity, and productivity targets.
Account Growth and Retention
Develop strong relationships with new and existing exhibitors, serving as a knowledgeable and trusted commercial partner.
Manage a portfolio of assigned accounts and identify opportunities for renewal, expansion, upselling, cross-selling, and multi-show participation.
Conduct structured post-show follow-up to review exhibitor outcomes, gather feedback, address concerns, and secure future participation.
Work proactively to reduce cancellations and improve exhibitor retention.
Maintain regular communication with customers throughout the event cycle to ensure expectations are clearly understood and appropriately managed.
Pipeline Management and Forecasting
Maintain complete and accurate customer, activity, opportunity, and contract information within the CRM.
Manage opportunities through clearly defined pipeline stages with documented next steps and realistic close dates.
Produce accurate weekly and monthly sales forecasts.
Monitor personal pacing against revenue goals, activity expectations, and event deadlines.
Use CRM data, category insights, sales reports, and market intelligence to prioritize accounts and identify areas of opportunity.
Maintain strong pipeline discipline and immediately escalate material risks, blockers, or forecast changes.
Collaboration and Event Delivery
Partner closely with marketing, operations, customer success, finance, and event leadership to deliver a strong exhibitor experience.
Provide customer and marketplace feedback to support product development, pricing, marketing campaigns, and show-floor strategy.
Coordinate the successful handoff of contracted exhibitors to the appropriate operational and customer-success teams.
Attend ASD Market Week and other relevant industry events, supporting customers onsite and developing new sales opportunities.
Represent ASD and Emerald professionally in all customer and industry interactions.

Two or more years of successful B2B sales, business development, account management, media sales, event sales, or sponsorship sales experience.

About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's first Regional Sales Managers in Argentina — one of the world's great cattle nations — building our customer presence in the region from the ground up.
We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into our very first local customers. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; as our first sales hire on the ground, you will be a foundational contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Argentina.
You'll be responsible for using your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers' farm systems. You'll detail Halter's value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal.

As the region scales, you'll help shape how we set quotas and commissions, build sales capability, and mentor the team that follows you. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.
Meeting high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.
Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.
Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.
Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.
Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.
Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.
Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.
Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.
Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.

A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.
Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.
Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.
Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.
Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.
A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.
Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

s.h: Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.
s.t:
Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.
A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.
Halter in Argentina
Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.
Join our team
Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement.

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram .

s.t:
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

We’re looking for people who combine technical understanding, commercial acumen, and strategic execution. This role may focus on one or more of the following areas: energy and power, land and real estate, colocation, cloud service providers, silicon, and data center equipment.
This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Lead negotiations for complex commercial agreements, balancing cost, speed, resilience, and long-term scalability.

Partner closely with engineering, finance, legal, and operations to structure and execute agreements that support OpenAI’s growth.

Unterfranken zählt zu den wirtschaftsstärksten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands – und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt – Praxis für Praxis.

Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.
Deine Aufgaben
Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet – von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen.
Nachhaltiges Umsatz- und Pipelinewachstum: Du verantwortest Deinen Erfolg, Deine Pipeline und Dein Netzwerk in der Region – und Du weißt, wie Du alle drei systematisch aufbaust und konsequent entwickelst.
Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt – und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss.
Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach.
Dein Profil
Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!
Nachgewiesene Stärke im Field Sales: Du bringst Vertriebserfahrung im Außendienst mit – idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld. Die Dynamik komplexer Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.
Neukundenakquise mit strategischem Blick: Du liebst es, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen – und Du gehst dabei nicht nach Bauchgefühl vor. Du analysierst, priorisierst und pitchst mit Präzision.
Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du bist davon überzeugt, dass smarte Technologie den Praxisalltag wirklich verbessern kann – und Du machst diese Überzeugung im Gespräch spürbar. Für Ärzt:innen, für Praxisteams, für den Markt.
Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du drückst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) aus; Deine Englischkenntnisse sind außerdem mindestens auf Konversationsniveau (B1).
Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, dass der größte Impact im direkten Kontakt entsteht – bei Ärzt:innen, in Praxen, in der Region. Ein Wohnort in Unterfranken (oder die Bereitschaft, umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deines Vertriebsgebiets sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind daher Voraussetzung.

Als Account Manager Performance Marketing (m/w/d) bei SPCTR. übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Kundenaccounts und wirst zu dem festen Ansprechpartner, dem unsere Kunden vertrauen. Wir arbeiten als verlängerte Online-Marketing-Abteilung, von wachsenden Start-ups bis zu namhaften größeren Unternehmen.
Deine Rolle sitzt genau an der Schnittstelle: Du führst deine Kunden souverän durch Jour Fixes und Quarterly Business Reviews und arbeitest gleichzeitig operativ in den Accounts, wenn Performance-Kampagnen auf Google, Meta, TikTok und Snapchat umgesetzt und optimiert werden. SEO und GEO gewinnen dabei zunehmend an Bedeutung, genauso wie der Einsatz von KI und Automatisierung im Alltag. Bei uns arbeitet das ganze Team mit Claude.
Was wir am meisten schätzen, lässt sich schwer in eine Anforderungsliste fassen: Proaktivität. Menschen, die Probleme früh benennen und mit einem Lösungsvorschlag um die Ecke kommen. Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst und unternehmerisch denkst, passt du zu uns.
Aufgaben
Du betreust eigene Kundenaccounts eigenverantwortlich und bist der feste Ansprechpartner für Strategie, Umsetzung und Ergebnisse.
Du führst Jour Fixes und Quarterly Business Reviews selbstständig, auch bei größeren Kunden mit mehreren Entscheidern und festen Entscheidungswegen.
Du setzt Performance-Kampagnen auf Google, Meta, TikTok und Snapchat operativ um und optimierst sie kontinuierlich entlang klarer KPIs.
Du denkst die Accounts ganzheitlich und bringst SEO- und GEO-Themen mit ins Spiel, wenn sie zu den Zielen des Kunden passen.
Du erstellst Analysen, Reportings und Dashboards und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für Kunden und Team ab.
Du nutzt KI-Tools und Automatisierungen aktiv im Tagesgeschäft, bei uns vor allem Claude, für Analysen, Reportings, Recherchen und operative Prozesse.
Du erkennst wiederkehrende Aufgaben und manuelle Workflows und denkst sie proaktiv in Richtung Automatisierung weiter.
Du benennst Probleme früh, transparent und mit einem Lösungsvorschlag im Gepäck.
Du behältst Markt, neue Plattform-Features sowie Entwicklungen rund um KI, Search und GEO im Blick und bringst Relevantes ins Team ein.
Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Performance, Content und Design zusammen, in flachen Hierarchien mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.
Qualifikation
Du bringst 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Online oder Performance Marketing mit, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit direktem Kundenkontakt.
Du hast ein Studium im Bereich BWL, Marketing, Kommunikation oder Vergleichbares abgeschlossen, eine passende Ausbildung gemacht oder dir dein Können in der Praxis erarbeitet.
Du bist kommunikationsstark und trittst gegenüber Kunden klar, souverän und professionell auf, auch wenn mehrere Entscheider und festgelegte Prozesse im Spiel sind.
Du kennst dich praktisch mit Google Ads und Meta Ads aus. Erfahrung mit Looker Studio, Google Analytics und Google Tag Manager ist ein Plus.
Du hast idealerweise ein Grundverständnis von SEO und GEO, gerne auch mehr, und richtig Lust, dich in diese Themen weiter einzuarbeiten.
Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools wie zum Beispiel Claude oder ChatGPT und siehst darin einen echten Hebel für produktiveres Arbeiten.
Du hast Drive: Du willst dich und das Unternehmen aktiv nach vorne entwickeln und übernimmst Verantwortung, ohne dass man dich darum bitten muss.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und priorisiert, und verlierst auch bei mehreren Projekten parallel nicht den Überblick.
Du kommst mit modernen Tools gut zurecht. Wir arbeiten mit awork sowie Microsoft 365 und Teams.
Du bist Teamplayer, schaust über den eigenen Tellerrand und unterstützt dein Kollegium, wenn es eng wird.

Ein offenes und engagiertes Team, das von den Gründern selbst geführt wird und einen starken Zusammenhalt pflegt. Auch nach der Arbeit.
Echte Account-Verantwortung von Anfang an, mit Kunden, bei denen du deine Wirkung siehst.
Ein Umfeld, in dem KI und Automatisierung ausdrücklich gewünscht sind und neue Tools und Ideen ausprobiert statt ausgebremst werden.
GEO und KI-Sichtbarkeit als Zukunftsthema, das du mit uns gemeinsam aufbaust.
Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, vollständig remote zu arbeiten.
Work from anywhere: Arbeite von dort, wo du am besten arbeiten kannst, plus die Möglichkeit, in unserem Büro in Köln zu arbeiten (optional auch Hamburg).
Spannende Start-ups und namhafte größere Kunden, an denen du fachlich schnell wächst.
Datengetriebenes Arbeiten, ehrliche Kommunikation und moderne Marketingprozesse.
Klingt das nach der richtigen Herausforderung für dich? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
Eigenschaften wie Drive und Lernfähigkeit zeigen sich selten im Kennenlerncall, sondern erst in der Zusammenarbeit. Deshalb halten wir den Prozess schlank und ehrlich: Wenn es von beiden Seiten passt, merken wir das schnell.
Wenn du Kunden souverän führen willst, Performance Marketing operativ stark umsetzt und Lust hast, SEO, GEO und KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen mit uns weiterzudenken, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil des Teams bei SPCTR.

s.h: These are our current challenges and future goals
s.t:

s.h: This is where we need your support
s.t:
Market Entry & Expansion — You build our business in Italy, with a focus on drugstores, pharmacies/parapharmacies, online retail and selected grocery partners.
Account Management — You manage existing customers and win new partners through compelling pitches and tailored product range proposals.
Promotions & Trade Marketing — You plan and coordinate promotions, point-of-sale materials and sampling campaigns together with the marketing team.
Cross-functional Collaboration — You work closely with internal teams across marketing, operations, regulatory and e-commerce.

Representation — You represent Glow25 at trade shows, customer meetings and industry events across Italy.

Several years of experience in key account management, ideally in FMCG, beauty or health
A strong understanding of the Italian retail landscape — drugstores, pharmacies/parapharmacies, online retail and grocery
Fluent Italian and English
Spanish is a nice to have (bonus if you can also work in/with Spanish-speaking partners or markets)
A structured, proactive way of working with a real hands-on attitude
Confident use of everyday tools: Google Workspace, Slack, Asana and a CRM system as well as AI
Experience with pharmacy / parapharmacy channels — especially knowledge of the specific mechanics, decision processes and trade marketing setup in that environment is a bonus

s.h: That's something you can look forward to

Work flexibly, in the way that suits you best. Work when and where you’re most productive – with flexible hours and smart time tracking.
Home office? Done right. We’ve got you covered: receive a one-time €500 allowance to set up your perfect workspace.
Fully equipped from day one. Mac or Windows – you choose what works best for you.
Glow Card – your monthly treat. Get €50 every month to spend however you like – that’s €600 a year, just because.
Learning is part of the deal. Whether it’s our Glowcademy, dedicated learning time, or personal development support – we invest in you, not just in numbers.
Let’s Glow! Enjoy 40% off our entire product range – yes, everything.

Thinking ahead. After your probation period, we’ll contribute €600 toward your pension plan – and if you add more, we’ll top it up with an extra 20%.
Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms.
Culture that truly shines. For five years in a row, we’ve been recognized as a Top Company on Kununu - proof of the strong, positive, and genuine culture we live every day.
Move your way. From workouts to wellness retreats – you decide how to stay active. Choose between Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.
Yay! You've made it this far!

Ease is hiring an Account Executive to help manufacturers improve quality, safety, and operational performance through our category-leading plant floor audit platform.

In this role, you'll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close, while partnering with some of the world's leading manufacturing organizations.

You'll join a growing team, sell a proven solution with strong market traction, and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both our customers and the company's continued growth.

Position Summary As an Account Executive at Ease, you’ll own the full sales cycle for enterprise manufacturing prospects, from first conversation to signed contract. You’re the first face these organizations see, and the impression you leave sets the tone for everything that follows.

You’ll build relationships across the org, from the plant floor to the C-suite, and you’ll understand the difference between the two audiences well enough to speak to both without changing your conviction.

In this role, you’ll work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to move qualified deals forward and hand off new customers in a way that sets them up to win. If you’re a hunter who also knows how to build trust, asks better questions than you give answers, and measures success by the deals that actually close: this one is for you.

Salary: $200k+ OTE What You'll Do:
Prospect, qualify, and engage enterprise-level manufacturing organizations. You’re not waiting for leads to come to you. You know your ICP, you know where to find them, and you know how to earn the first conversation.
Build and manage a qualified pipeline. The majority of it will be self-sourced. Quality over volume. Know what’s real and what’s wishful, and have the discipline to tell the difference. A clean pipeline is a credible pipeline.
Run discovery that goes deeper than features and functions. Understand what a quality or safety problem actually costs the people in the room. Not just the business on paper, but the plant manager who’s been dealing with it for two years.
Deliver compelling product demonstrations that are tailored, not templated. The demo should feel like it was built for that customer, because it was. Show them their world in the product, not a generic walkthrough.
Partner with Marketing and Customer Success to move deals forward and hand off new customers in a way that sets them up for long-term success. The close isn’t the finish line. It’s the starting line.
Stay sharp on the manufacturing landscape: the pressures, the priorities, and the language of the people you’re selling to. The best reps in this space earn credibility on the plant floor, not just in the boardroom.
Own the full sales cycle. Prospecting through close. Negotiate with confidence, manage multiple stakeholders across the org, and drive deals to a decision, in either direction. Knowing when to walk away is part of the job.

3+ years of experience in a closing role, with a track record of winning new business in enterprise-level accounts. You know what it takes to move a complex deal and you’ve done it more than once.
Strong communication skills, but more importantly, strong listening skills. You ask the right questions and know how to create space for the prospect to arrive at the answer themselves.
Competitive and accountable, without needing external pressure to stay on track. You set your own standard, and it’s a high one. You also know when to walk away from the wrong deal and redirect your energy.
A consultative approach to discovery. You understand that the personal cost of a problem is just as important as the business case. You know how to find both, and you know how to connect them to the people making the decision.
Genuine curiosity about the manufacturing sector. You don’t need to be an industry veteran, but you need to be the kind of person who wants to understand how things are made, where the problems live, and what keeps a plant manager up at night.
Comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with long cycles. You know how to keep momentum without pushing. You build relationships across the org, not just with the person who signs the paper.
Proficiency with Salesforce, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo.

Industry leaders, including Aston Martin, Dana, 3M, Tenneco, and Samsung, trust EASE to facilitate and analyze millions of plant floor audits every year. With deployments in over 40 countries, EASE supports more than 25 languages, solidifying its position as a category leader for quality management, as recognized by G2 and Gartner.
